newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hsin Chong to buy HK$117.5 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Hsin Chong to buy HK$117.5 mln property.

text.p: Hsin Chong Construction Group Ltd said on Wednesday it would buy a 10-storey industrial building in Kwun Tong in Kowloon from third party Merrison Garment Co Ltd for HK$117.50 million The building construction and civil engineering group said the purchase would be funded by internal resources and bank borrowings.

"The property is intended to be redeveloped from industrial building to industrial/office building subject to approval from the relevant authorities by way of modification of the present lease conditions and payment of premium," the company said.
It said the property at Wai Yip Street in Kwun Tong had a total gross floor area of about 107,000 square feet.
Upon completion of the redevelopment in 1999, at least half of the property would be utilized by the company with the remaining for leasing to generate recurrent rental income, it said.
